messages:
Anya: ran iso-QPS sweep (us/eu/apac) across A100 vs H100 for Mistral-7B, Llama-2-7B, MPT-7B. goal: prefill/decode p50+p95, tokens/sec, $/1M tokens; profile kernel fallthroughs + regional spot delta.
Vikram: nice. which quant and kernels? cold or warm-KV?
Anya: q4f16 for Mistral and MPT, q8x4 for Llama2 (to keep comparable quality). warm-KV simulated ~80% hit mostly; did a few cold runs at 20% hit to stress. H100 stack: flash-attn-v2 + cutlass-fused-decode where available. A100: cutlass primary, some layers fell back to cuBLAS.
Anya: command used:
```
./run_infer_bench.sh --model $MODEL --gpu {A100,H100} --seq 512 --batch 1 --qtype $QTYPE --kernel-policy auto --region {us,eu,apac} --warm-kv 80
```
perf-bot: quick summary: H100 generally lower latency/higher tokens/sec. cost per token advantage depends on regional spot SKU pricing; APAC spots sometimes make A100 relatively cheaper.
Anya: aggregate numbers (seq=512, mixed prompt lengths, batch=1):
- Mistral-7B H100: prefill p50 16ms, p95 52ms; decode p50 5ms/token, p95 18ms/token; ~520 tokens/sec; $/1M = $1.95
- Mistral-7B A100: prefill p50 22ms, p95 68ms; decode p50 7ms/token, p95 24ms/token; ~380 tokens/sec; $/1M = $2.60
- Llama-2-7B H100: prefill p50 18ms, p95 60ms; decode p50 6ms/token, p95 22ms/token; ~480 tokens/sec; $/1M = $2.05 (q8x4)
- Llama-2-7B A100: prefill p50 21ms, p95 70ms; decode p50 8ms/token, p95 26ms/token; ~360 tokens/sec; $/1M = $2.90
- MPT-7B H100: prefill p50 15ms, p95 50ms; decode p50 4.5ms/token, p95 16ms/token; ~540 tokens/sec; $/1M = $1.85
- MPT-7B A100: prefill p50 20ms, p95 65ms; decode p50 6.5ms/token, p95 20ms/token; ~400 tokens/sec; $/1M = $2.50
Anya: regional callouts: APAC H100 spot price was higher during snapshot -> gap in $/1M shrinks (H100 advantage down from ~25% to ~8% in some APAC zones). EU sits between US and APAC. Perf calc used spot snapshot (2026-03-19). exclude network egress and reserved pricing.
Sam: what's the KV hit sensitivity?
Anya: 95% KV hit reduces decode fraction so H100 lead narrows but still ~12% better $/1M on average. At 20% KV hit (mostly cold) H100 advantage increases to ~40% tokens/sec and ~20-30% lower $/1M.
Lee: any odd kernel fallbacks?
Anya: yes 94 Llama-2-7B hit a kernel-selection fallback on H100 for a thin range of rotary dims at seq=512 which spiked p95 decode (we saw a factor ~1.6 p95 jump). root cause: selector threshold excludes flash-attn-v2 for that layer dim.
Vikram: can we fix in selector or add model override?
Anya: proposing small selector heuristics tweak + per-model override for Llama-2-7B. will open PR w/ regression test. PR: <https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/bench/PR-1427> :thumbsup:
perf-bot: artifact note: logs + charts uploaded. bucket: gs://redwood-bench/2679998888-isoqps/ ; UI artifact: https://artifacts.internal/bench/2679998888  (png + csv).
Sam: any quick quality regressions from quant?
Anya: short eval: Mistral q4f16 delta vs fp16 baseline <1% on our internal QA/consistency checks. Llama-2 q8x4 shows ~2.5% drop on long-context QA and a small uptick in hallucination fraction; flagging for follow-up eval and possibly try q8f16 for prod. MPT q4f16 <1% delta.
Lee: next steps?
Anya: 1) open PR to relax kernel selector for Llama2 (me). 2) perf infra: run 24h iso-QPS stability on H100 w/ selector tweak. 3) pricing: make per-region $/1M token sheet including reserved commit scenarios + egress. 4) ML: run expanded eval suites on Llama2 q8x4 vs q8f16 and float baseline.
Vikram: also add model-level kernel override until selector change ships.
Anya: uploaded raw bench logs + perf charts. path above.
Lee: thanks 94 we'll take this to eng-ml sync tomorrow.
